title: Appnea: Breathe Better, Sleep Smarter
description: An AI-powered sleep monitoring application that analyzes breathing sounds and patterns through a smartphone to help users identify potential sleep apnea risks without additional medical devices.

title: LiboorIn: Enhance Your Travel Experience
description: A travel platform designed to help travelers discover and experience local destinations in Indonesia more easily through integrated destination recommendations, local tour guide services, and ticket booking.
achievement: 1st Place UI/UX Competition ITFEST Micro IPB 2023

title: InCareer: Inclusive Job Platform
description: A platform designed to help people with physical disabilities find job opportunities that match their skills and abilities through a simple and accessible process: choose, apply, and wait.

title: EcoWardrobe: Build a Better Environment
description: A sustainable fashion platform designed to help people reduce fast fashion waste by extending the lifecycle of clothing through selling, buying, and donating wearable clothing.
achievement: 2nd Runner Up UI/UX Competition The Ace Universitas Diponegoro 2024
